objectives.title: Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the latent field state
objectives.description: Develop and calibrate a probabilistic diagnostic method that fuses multi-source Earth observation (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, optional PlanetScope), in-situ soil sensors, weather data and field observations into estimates of the latent field state (root-zone soil moisture, crop water stress, canopy condition), returning full posteriors rather than point estimates. Two interchangeable routes are in scope: Route A (direct one-step probabilistic fusion) and Route B (homogeneous-patch proxy).
objectives.measurable_target: A calibrated diagnostic model that outputs the target field-state variables with explicit, honest uncertainty (posterior/prediction intervals). The precise target field state (RQ3) and whether one or both routes are implemented (RQ2) are open project decisions; the verifiable target is uncertainty-calibrated field-state estimation, not a fabricated accuracy percentage.

objectives.title: Uncertainty-aware decision engine for irrigation choice
objectives.description: Develop the prognostic decision engine that turns the diagnosed field state into an irrigation recommendation: calibrate the FAO AquaCrop model in an uncertainty-aware way that retains an honest parameter posterior, run counterfactual irrigation simulations over weather ensembles, and select the option with the best expected economic return.
objectives.measurable_target: An integrated decision engine that scores candidate irrigation decisions by expected profit (expected crop value minus costs) under weather and model uncertainty, propagating uncertainty from diagnosis into the recommendation. The exact decision objective (profit vs weighted multi-objective) is an open decision (RQ6).

objectives.title: Field validation and honest uncertainty calibration
objectives.description: Design and execute a validation protocol establishing that the diagnosis and the decision recommendations are credible: collect ground truth, assess whether the reported uncertainty is well calibrated (e.g. whether 90% prediction intervals contain the truth about 90% of the time), and, for Route B, test that the chosen homogeneous patch genuinely covaries with the target crop.
objectives.measurable_target: A validation protocol with defined ground-truth measurements (RQ4), uncertainty-calibration metrics (RQ5), pilot-success criteria (RQ7) and a patch-covariation test (RQ9). These four items define a protocol that does not yet exist and must be specified with the (unresolved) host and validation sites; no validation numbers are asserted.

objectives.title: Standalone research demonstrator (web MVP)
objectives.description: Integrate the diagnosis and decision engine into a standalone research demonstrator (a web MVP / user interface) that presents recommendations with their uncertainty, as a research artefact rather than an operational product.
objectives.measurable_target: A working end-to-end demonstrator that exercises the full observation-to-decision pipeline. The TRL target (research prototype vs validated MVP vs operational pilot) is an open project decision (RQ10) and is NOT asserted.
source_vault_nodes: Web MVP and User Interface Layer (METH-INFRA-010)
objectives.note: The demonstrator framing is vault synthesis (Web MVP node is synthesis, confidence low); the TRL target is Unresolved (RQ10).

objectives.title: Advancement of the fellow's competences and career
objectives.description: Enhance the researcher's scientific, technical and transferable competences and career perspectives through the fellowship's training, supervision and two-way transfer of knowledge (MSCA-PF Impact criterion 2.1 / Excellence criterion 1.3).
objectives.measurable_target: By month 24: a Career Development Plan agreed with the supervisor and submitted as a deliverable by month 3; at least 3 peer-reviewed publications (>=2 as first author); >=120 hours of transferable-skills training (research integrity, open science, FAIR data stewardship, entrepreneurship); co-supervision of >=1 MSc thesis at the host; >=2 international conference presentations; and two-way transfer of knowledge evidenced by >=2 methods seminars delivered at the host on uncertainty-aware crop-water modelling.
